newsitem.title: USA: N.J. Treasurer was in talks for new job - paper.
newsitem.headline: N.J. Treasurer was in talks for new job - paper.

text.p: New Jersey Treasurer Brian Clymer had discussions about a possible job with a person who does business with the state, the Star Ledger said Tuesday.

Clymer told Gov Christine Whitman, however, that the discussions have ended. While they were ongoing, the Treasurer recused himself from any decisions involving the person, whom the paper did not name.
Rumors that Clymer was leaving his post as Treasurer began circulating in Trenton almost as soon as he took office.
Whitman said she has no problem with cabinet members holding discussions with potential employees, as long as they avoid conflicts of interest during the talks.
